items.quote: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh
items.claim: Workers encountered Moses and Aaron positioned in their path as they exited Pharaoh's presence
Moses and Aaron positioned themselves in the workers' path

items.quote: as they came forth from Pharaoh

items.claim: Workers spoke to Moses and Aaron

items.quote: The LORD look upon you, and judge
items.claim: Workers invoked the LORD to look upon and judge Moses and Aaron

items.quote: ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants
items.claim: Moses and Aaron caused Pharaoh and his servants to abhor the Israelites
items.place: in the eyes of Pharaoh, in the eyes of his servants

items.quote: to put a sword in their hand to slay us
items.claim: Swords were placed in servants' hands to kill the workers
items.mechanism: put a sword in their hand
